description:
We’re a 3-person family team from Honolulu, Hawaiʻi. We love music, science, and technology. Our team includes a high school 10th grader who loves computer science and sings opera, a mom who is a science nerd with a talent for music, and a dad who works at an education nonprofit.

Our team is named after a local bird, the Kōlea, which makes an amazing migration across the Pacific between Alaska and Hawaiʻi every year. We're Kōlea Sound Lab!
